rule Suspicious_PowerShell_Encoding {
    meta:
        description = "Detects base64-encoded PowerShell commands often used in obfuscation"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1059.001"

    strings:
        $base64 = /powershell.*-enc.*/ nocase
        $b64_decode = { 64 65 63 6F 64 65 } /* 'decode' in hex */
    condition:
        $base64 or $b64_decode
}
